mapper.sql: select p.payment_id, p.payment_no, p.order_id, p.provider, p.provider_payment_id, p.method, p.amount, p.currency_code, p.payment_status, p.idempotency_key, p.paid_at, p.expired_at, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, o.order_no from payments p left join orders o on o.order_id = p.order_id
mapper.select: where p.order_id = #{orderId} order by p.payment_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into payments (payment_no, order_id, provider, provider_payment_id, method, amount, currency_code, payment_status, idempotency_key, paid_at, expired_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{paymentNo}, #{orderId}, #{provider}, #{providerPaymentId}, #{method}, #{amount}, #{currencyCode}, #{paymentStatus}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{paidAt}, #{expiredAt}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select p.payment_id as paymentId, p.payment_no as paymentNo, p.provider as provider, p.method as method, p.amount as channelAmount, p.currency_code as currencyCode, p.payment_status as paymentStatus, p.paid_at as paidAt, o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.total_amount as systemAmount, o.payment_status as orderPaymentStatus, o.order_status as orderStatus, o.shop_id as shopId from payments p left join orders o on o.order_id = p.order_id where date(ifnull(p.paid_at, p.create_time)) = #{statDate} order by p.payment_id desc
